verses.text: Then He said to me, 'Son of man, stand on your feet that I may speak with you!'
verses.textZh: 他對我說：人子啊，你站起來，我要和你說話。

verses.text: As He spoke to me the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet; and I heard [Him] speaking to me.
verses.textZh: 他對我說話的時候，靈就進入我裡面，使我站起來，我便聽見那位對我說話的聲音。

verses.text: Then He said to me, 'Son of man, I am sending you to the sons of Israel, to a rebellious people who have rebelled against Me; they and their fathers have transgressed against Me to this very day.
verses.textZh: 他對我說：人子啊，我差你往悖逆的國民以色列人那裡去。他們是悖逆我的，他們和他們的列祖違背我，直到今日。

verses.text: 'I am sending you to them who are stubborn and obstinate children, and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord GOD.'
verses.textZh: 這眾子面無羞恥，心裡剛硬。我差你往他們那裡去，你要對他們說：主耶和華如此說。

verses.text: 'As for them, whether they listen or not-- for they are a rebellious house-- they will know that a prophet has been among them.
verses.textZh: 他們或聽，或不聽，（他們是悖逆之家），必知道在他們中間有了先知。

verses.text: 'And you, son of man, neither fear them nor fear their words, though thistles and thorns are with you and you sit on scorpions; neither fear their words nor be dismayed at their presence, for they are a rebellious house.
verses.textZh: 人子啊，雖有荊棘和蒺藜在你那裡，你又住在蠍子中間，總不要怕他們，也不要怕他們的話；他們雖是悖逆之家，還不要怕他們的話，也不要因他們的臉色驚惶。

verses.text: 'But you shall speak My words to them whether they listen or not, for they are rebellious.
verses.textZh: 他們或聽，或不聽，你只管將我的話告訴他們；他們是極其悖逆的。

verses.text: 'Now you, son of man, listen to what I am speaking to you; do not be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth and eat what I am giving you.'
verses.textZh: 人子啊，要聽我對你所說的話，不要悖逆像那悖逆之家，你要開口吃我所賜給你的。

verses.text: Then I looked, and behold, a hand was extended to me; and lo, a scroll [was] in it.
verses.textZh: 我觀看，見有一隻手向我伸出來，手中有一書卷。

verses.text: When He spread it out before me, it was written on the front and back, and written on it were lamentations, mourning and woe.
verses.textZh: 他將書卷在我面前展開，內外都寫著字，其上所寫的有哀號、歎息、悲痛的話。
